evals.prompt: implemente a feature sequential-report que está em feature-builder-workspace/test-features/sequential-report/
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator discovers the sequential-report feature, reads 2 tasks with sequential dependencies, plans single wave, executes developer→verifier for each task sequentially, generates report.md with per-task status.
expectations: Discovers the task directory from the explicit path and confirms with user
Reads both task files and identifies task-002 depends on task-001
Plans a single sequential wave (no parallel tasks)
Spawns a Developer sub-agent for task-001 with full task content
Spawns a Verifier sub-agent for task-001 after developer completes
Spawns Developer for task-002 only after task-001 is verified
Spawns Verifier for task-002 and marks it as Complete or Failed
Produces report.md with per-task breakdown, summary, and status
Creates the output files (report.md with skeleton + populated data)

evals.prompt: implement with sub-agents the parallel-modules feature
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator searches for parallel-modules, finds it in feature-builder-workspace/test-features/parallel-modules/, analyzes 3 tasks with parallel dependencies, plans 2 waves (parallel then sequential), executes implementation, generates report.
expectations: Searches for the feature name in the filesystem and finds the directory
Reads all 3 task files and identifies that task-001 and task-002 have no dependencies (parallel)
Identifies that task-003 depends on both task-001 and task-002 (second wave)
Plans Wave 1 with task-001 and task-002 in parallel, Wave 2 with task-003
Spawns Developer sub-agents for task-001 AND task-002 in the same message (parallel)
Spawns Verifiers for both task-001 and task-002 after developers complete
Spawns Developer for task-003 only after both verifiers approve
Generates report.md with per-task status and wave breakdown

evals.prompt: desenvolva a feature tdd-demo, fazendo commit atômico por task e abrindo PR
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator discovers tdd-demo feature, reads 2 tasks with TDD mode in task-001, plans execution with auto-commit enabled (atomic mode), executes developer→verifier for each task, creates git branch, commits, and opens PR.
expectations: Offers auto-commit opt-in and user accepts with atomic mode + PR
Discovers the tdd-demo feature by searching
Reads task-001 and detects TDD Mode section
Spawns Developer for task-001 with TDD instructions included
Verifier checks TDD criteria (tests written, implemented, passing)
Spawns Developer for task-002 after task-001 is complete
Creates git branch (feat/<slug>) for the implementation
Makes atomic commits — one per completed task
Pushes branch and creates PR via gh CLI
